applicable_to: ACM journal publications using the standard acmart acmsmall format.
notes: Class is auto-fetched by Tectonic at compile time; no bundled class file needed. Affiliation requires a \country field (enforced by recent acmart versions). \acmJournal{} must be one of acmart's recognized journal codes (e.g. JACM) -- not an arbitrary placeholder string, or compilation fails with 'Incorrect journal'. Citation style: ACM reference format. main.tex's front matter was cross-checked against the official sample-acmsmall.tex (acmart package) to include received-date history (\received/[revised]/[accepted]), a funding \thanks footnote, and journal volume/number/article metadata. Body is a real filled-in illustrative paper (a caching strategy for approximate nearest neighbor search), not placeholder text. Needed \raggedbottom to resolve a page-break Underfull vbox warning. Contains 3 real matplotlib-generated figures: a median-latency and a hit-rate line chart (both vs. cache budget) in Experiments/Results, plus a log-log query-frequency-vs-rank plot in the Introduction motivating the skew claim empirically. Latency values were regenerated once after an initial version dipped below zero at large cache budgets (physically impossible) -- fixed with a saturating exponential-decay curve instead of an unbounded log curve. ACM_Journal_Template.pdf is a kept compiled reference render, excluded from get_template_files like all PDFs. Verified to compile cleanly with zero Overfull/Underfull warnings.
